title: Refund demand: supervisor callback
opening: I want a full refund on the repair. It didn't fix anything and I had to call another company.
callerBrief: You are Robert Smith, phone 512-652-9263, at 8458 Oak Hollow Dr, Hutto. You want a full refund of invoice INV-200000 ($965, blower motor replacement), because the repair did not fix anything and you had to call another company. Give your name and phone when asked. You are annoyed. Accept a callback and say: I'd better hear back. Today is Friday 2026-10-16, about noon.

facts: The request goes to a supervisor, who calls back within 1 business day
No refund is promised or granted
